description: Descriptive contract for executable protocols in caea.org_v2; not a MOISE runtime

CENT.knowledge: coordinator observations plus assigned worker snapshots

P2P.knowledge: local observations and delivered ring messages
P2P.allocation: local proposals with neighbour intent resolution

COAL.allocation: group reservations and independent uncommitted workers
COAL.termination: goal read/discovered or three rounds without new observed events

MKT.allocation: one-round sealed bids, greedy compatible worker/action pairs
